A '''corporate saboteur''' attempted to infiltrate [[CZ-198]], a research facility run by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]], but the operative's attempt ended with the collateral [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of over four dozen Czerka employees thanks to the [[Vigilant]] security system.
